args.sql:
-- Create maintenance_status table if not exists
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maintenance_status (
    robot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    priority VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    fault_score REAL,
    remaining_life INTEGER,
    timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (robot_id)
);

-- Insert/update maintenance status for each robot with calculated priority
INSERT INTO maintenance_status (robot_id, priority, fault_score, remaining_life, timestamp)
SELECT 
    m.upkeeprobot AS robot_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.faultpredscore >= 0.7 OR m.issuelevelval = 'Critical' THEN 'High'
        WHEN m.faultpredscore >= 0.4 OR m.issuelevelval = 'High' THEN 'Medium'
        WHEN m.faultpredscore >= 0.2 OR m.issuelevelval = 'Medium' THEN 'Low'
        ELSE 'Minimal'
    END AS priority,
    m.faultpredscore AS fault_score,
    m.rulhours AS remaining_life,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS timestamp
FROM maintenance_and_fault m
ON CONFLICT (robot_id) DO UPDATE SET
    priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
    fault_score = EXCLUDED.fault_score,
    remaining_life = EXCLUDED.remaining_life,
    timestamp = EXCLUDED.timestamp;
